title: pipelines → studio's projector: a batch's status changed
description: Subject evt.pipeline.<batch_id>.batch (stream EVT), Nats-Msg-Id <batch_id>:<seq>. pipelines_service is the only writer of a batch's status. `seq` is per batch over both evt.pipeline.* kinds, allocated and committed before publishing (gaps are normal, a seq is never reused); the projector dedupes on (job_id, seq) and ignores a batch event whose seq is not above the last batch event it applied.

reason.description: why it is paused or failed, user-readable: `paused by you`, `the pipeline service restarted; press Resume`, `3 rows in a row failed: <error>`; required (non-empty) with paused and failed
